feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is 100% self-certified grass-fed through the State of Maine.

notes: Checked the homepage, Maine grass fed beef page and about us page. Jason and Kristin Stutheit raise Wagyu, Angus and Hereford cattle in Brooks and sell state-inspected individual cuts by the pound or hanging-weight quarters, halves and wholes. The site only says to call or email for availability and does not describe pickup, delivery or shipping, so farm-pickup is inferred and the Verifier should confirm. No finishing statement found, so grass-fed was chosen. Email jstutheit84@gmail.com. The site also offers a farm stay. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
